lessons.title: Basic Family Relations
lessons.concept: Blood relation problems describe family links and ask you to identify how two people are related. Core relations include parent-child, siblings, spouse, grandparents-grandchildren, uncle/aunt, nephew/niece, and cousins. Gender matters for terms like brother/sister, son/daughter, uncle/aunt.
lessons.formula: Map each statement to a generation and gender: parent = +1 generation, child = -1, sibling/spouse = same generation.
lessons.worked_example: A is the father of B. B is the sister of C. Therefore A is the father of C as well (same parent). C's gender is not specified unless stated.
mistakes: Assuming gender when not stated (e.g., 'child' could be son or daughter)
Confusing maternal and paternal relations when side is specified
Mixing same-generation relations (sibling vs spouse) incorrectly

lessons.title: Chained and Pointing Relations
lessons.concept: Many questions chain relations ('X is the son of Y, who is the daughter of Z') or use pointing/introductions ('He is the son of my father's only son'). Solve step by step from a known reference person, often yourself or a clearly identified person, and simplify the phrase before mapping generations.
lessons.formula: Resolve inner phrases first and track perspective ('my', 'his', 'her') and conditions like 'only son/daughter' carefully.
lessons.worked_example: Pointing to a man, Riya says, 'He is the son of my mother's only daughter.' If Riya is that only daughter, the man is Riya's son.
mistakes: Skipping the 'only' condition in phrases like only son/only daughter
Losing track of whose perspective ('my', 'his', 'her') is used
Not breaking long chains into smaller steps

lessons.title: Solving with Diagrams and Codes
lessons.concept: Drawing a simple family tree (generations vertically, spouses/siblings horizontally) reduces confusion. In coded relations, replace each symbol with its meaning and evaluate in the correct order as defined. Always confirm the final relation asked (of A to B vs B to A).
lessons.formula: Direction check: 'A is brother of B' means A is male sibling of B; relation of B to A may be brother or sister depending on B's gender.
lessons.worked_example: If P is brother of Q and Q is mother of R, then P is maternal uncle of R (brother of R's mother). Relation of R to P is niece/nephew depending on R's gender.
mistakes: Answering inverse relation (uncle instead of nephew/niece) when question asks the reverse
Ignoring generation shifts in uncle/aunt/grandparent relations
Assuming spouse gender from name in exam logic unless explicitly stated

practice.question: A is the brother of B. B is the sister of C. How is A related to C?
practice.explanation: A and B are siblings, and B and C are siblings. Therefore A is a brother of C (A is male).

practice.question: P is the father of Q. Q is the mother of R. How is P related to R?
practice.explanation: P is parent of Q and Q is parent of R, so P is one generation above Q and two above R: grandfather (paternal grandfather of R, since Q is R's mother and P is Q's father).
practice.provenance: Authored original practice item; not scraped. Requires independent verification before TRUSTED promotion.

practice.question: Pointing to a woman, Rahul said, 'She is the daughter of my father's only son.' How is the woman related to Rahul?
practice.explanation: Rahul's father's only son is Rahul himself (in this context). So the woman is the daughter of Rahul, i.e., Rahul's daughter.
practice.provenance: Authored original practice item; not scraped. Requires independent verification before TRUSTED promotion.

practice.question: M is the sister of N. N is the father of O. How is M related to O?
practice.explanation: M is N's sister and N is O's father, so M is the sister of O's father, which makes M O's aunt.
practice.provenance: Authored original practice item; not scraped. Requires independent verification before TRUSTED promotion.

practice.question: A is B's mother. C is B's father. D is C's father. How is D related to A?
practice.explanation: C is A's spouse (both parents of B). D is C's father, so D is the father of A's husband, i.e., A's father-in-law.
practice.provenance: Authored original practice item; not scraped. Requires independent verification before TRUSTED promotion.

questions.question: X is the son of Y. Y is the daughter of Z. Z is the wife of W. How is X related to W?
questions.explanation: Y is daughter of Z and W, so Y is their child. X is son of Y, making X a grandchild of Z and W. Since X is male, X is W's grandson.
questions.provenance: Authored original question; not scraped. Requires independent verification before TRUSTED promotion.

questions.question: Pointing to a boy, Ritu said, 'He is the son of my mother's daughter.' Ritu has no sister. How is the boy related to Ritu?
questions.explanation: Ritu's mother's daughter could be Ritu or Ritu's sister. Since Ritu has no sister, 'my mother's daughter' refers to Ritu herself. Therefore the boy is the son of Ritu, i.e., Ritu's son.
questions.provenance: Authored original question; not scraped. Requires independent verification before TRUSTED promotion.

questions.question: If A is the brother of B, B is the sister of C, and C is the father of D, how is A related to D?
questions.explanation: A is sibling of B and C (same generation). C is father of D, so A is brother of D's father, i.e., D's uncle.
questions.provenance: Authored original question; not scraped. Requires independent verification before TRUSTED promotion.

questions.question: P is Q's brother. R is Q's mother. S is R's father. How is P related to S?
questions.explanation: R is mother of P and Q. S is father of R, so S is grandfather of R's children. Therefore P is grandson of S.
questions.provenance: Authored original question; not scraped. Requires independent verification before TRUSTED promotion.

questions.question: Looking at a photograph, Anil said, 'She is the only daughter of my mother's father.' How is the woman in the photograph related to Anil?
questions.explanation: Anil's mother's father is Anil's maternal grandfather. The only daughter of Anil's maternal grandfather is Anil's mother (in this stated context).
